captions.detailed: A medieval siege bombard consisting of a short, squat wrought-iron barrel in dark charcoal gray, nestled within a heavy timber trough cradle made of brown wood panels. The barrel has distinct reinforcing hoops and is supported by two cylindrical trunnions on either side that sit in semi-circular notches in the cradle's side walls. This trunnion configuration allows the barrel to rotate on a single revolute joint axis, adjusting its elevation angle for high-trajectory siege firing.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a medieval siege bombard featuring a dark iron barrel with reinforcing bands and side trunnions, supported by a heavy wooden trough cradle with notched side plates. The barrel should be linked to the wooden frame via a revolute joint to allow realistic elevation adjustment.
captions.factory: The cradle is built as a base link using rectangular boxes for the side support plates (with notched cutouts), the bottom trough, and crossbeams, styled with a brown wood material. The barrel is constructed as a separate link by lofting or unioning concentric cylinders of varying radii to create the stepped, reinforced look of a medieval bombard, complete with a hollow bore and protruding side trunnions. A revolute joint is then defined at the axis of the trunnions, anchoring the barrel to the cradle notches.
